function g77OtKeyHe(k){const p=k.split('.'),N=G77_OT_NAME,U={fps:'FPS',p95:'p95 (ms)',p99:'p99 (ms)',o100:'פריימים מעל 100ms',max:'הפריים הארוך (ms)',open:'פתיחה — הארוכה מ-5 (ms, מידע)',close:'סגירה — הארוכה מ-5 (ms, מידע)',openMed:'פתיחה — חציון של 5 (ms)',closeMed:'סגירה — חציון של 5 (ms)',first:'פתיחה ראשונה (ms)',ops:'פעולות ציור לפריים',mpx:'מיליון פיקסלים לפריים'};
 if(p[0]==='seg')return(N[p[1]]||p[1])+' · '+(U[p[2]]||p[2]);if(p[0]==='gd')return'ציור · '+(N[p[1]]||p[1])+' · '+(U[p[2]]||p[2]);if(p[0]==='ui')return(N[p[1]]||p[1])+' · '+(U[p[2]]||p[2]);
 if(p[0]==='bench')return'Benchmark '+(PERF_MODE_HE[p[1]]||p[1])+' · '+p[2]+' · '+(U[p[3]]||p[3]);
 return{'save.manual':'שמירה ידנית — קיפאון (ms)','save.auto':'שמירה אוטומטית — קיפאון (ms)','load':'טעינה — קיפאון (ms)','load.total':'טעינה — עד שהמשחק ממשיך (ms)','save.kb':'גודל השמירה (KB)','boot.smooth':'פתיחה עד שאפשר לשחק (ms)','boot.restore':'פתיחה מחדש בסוף הבדיקה (ms)','mem.heap':'זיכרון JS — בפתיחה, בקירוב של Chrome (MB, מידע)','mem.cmb':'תמונות — המרבי (MB)','hidden.back':'חזרה מחלון מוסתר — הפריים הארוך (ms)','long.fps':'ריצה ארוכה · FPS ממוצע','long.p95':'ריצה ארוכה · p95 ממוצע (ms)','long.o100':'ריצה ארוכה · פריימים מעל 100ms','long.heapEnd':'ריצה ארוכה · זיכרון JS בסוף (MB, מידע — בקירוב של Chrome)'}[k]||k}

function g77OtCompare(M,P,R,H){const rows=[],NZ=g77OtNoise(H),reA=new Set(R?g77OtRe(R):[]),reB=new Set(P.re||G77_OT_RE0[P.date]||[]),mA=R?g77OtMeta(R):{},mB=P.meta||null;    
 const taxiOk=()=>{const a=mA.taxi,b=mB&&mB.taxi;if(!a||!b||a.dest!==b.dest||a.x0==null||b.x0==null)return false;return Math.hypot(a.x0-b.x0,a.y0-b.y0)<=40};    
 for(const [k,[v,dir]] of Object.entries(M)){const q=P.m&&P.m[k];if(!q)continue;const p=q[0];const floor=/^(save|load|boot)/.test(k)?20:/o100$/.test(k)?2:/\.(ops)$/.test(k)?20:/mpx$/.test(k)?.1:2;
  const g=g77OtGrp(k),n=NZ.N[k],thr=Math.max(10,n!=null?n:15),info=/^ui\.\w+\.(open|close)$/.test(k)||/^(mem\.heap|long\.heapEnd)$/.test(k);    let nc=null;if(g==='seg.taxi'&&!taxiOk())nc='המונית לא יצאה מאותה נקודה לאותו יעד';else if(/^ui\./.test(k)&&!!mA.uiw!==!!(mB&&mB.uiw))nc='הממשק נמדד מעכשיו אחרי שהמצלמה חזרה אל השחקן (p326); לפני — המעבר היה בתוך הפתיחה הראשונה';else if(g&&reA.has(g)!==reB.has(g))nc='באחת הריצות הקטע נמדד שוב (על מטמונים חמים)';
  if(!(p>0)){rows.push({k,p,v,pct:null,thr,nc,info,reg:!nc&&!info&&dir<0&&v-p>=floor});continue}const worse=(dir>0?(p-v)/p:(v-p)/p)*100,big=Math.abs(v-p)>=floor;
  rows.push({k,p,v,pct:Math.round((v-p)/p*100),thr,nc,info,reg:!nc&&!info&&big&&worse>thr,better:!nc&&!info&&big&&worse<-thr,noise:!nc&&!info&&big&&Math.abs(worse)>10&&Math.abs(worse)<=thr})}
 return{build:P.build,date:P.date,rows,reg:rows.filter(r=>r.reg),better:rows.filter(r=>r.better),noise:rows.filter(r=>r.noise),nc:rows.filter(r=>r.nc&&!r.info)}}

function g77ZnCrc(u8){let T=G77_ZONES.crcT;if(!T){T=G77_ZONES.crcT=new Uint32Array(256);for(let n=0;n<256;n++){let c=n;for(let k=0;k<8;k++)c=c&1?0xEDB88320^(c>>>1):c>>>1;T[n]=c>>>0}}

async function g77ZnSettle(s){const raf=()=>new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(r)),t0=performance.now();let st=0,last=null,n=0;

async function g77ZnShot(s,R){const src=GAME_CTX.canvas,d=devicePixelRatio||1,fs=Math.round(13*d),strip=Math.round(fs*2.6),c=G77_ZONES.cv||(G77_ZONES.cv=window.document.createElement('canvas'));

 const t1=s.n+' · '+(s.k==='zone'?'האזור כולו':s.k==='border'?'גבול בין אזורים':'רשת')+' · אזורים: '+s.zones.join(', ')+(s.road?' · '+s.road:''),
  t2='x '+Math.round(s.x)+' · y '+Math.round(s.y)+' · זום '+s.z+' · '+g77OtShort(BUILD)+' · '+R.stamp;
 x.font='600 '+fs+'px "Segoe UI",Arial';x.direction='rtl';x.textAlign='right';x.fillStyle='#ffe08a';x.fillText(t1,c.width-fs*.7,src.height+fs*1.1);

 return{blob,crc:g77ZnCrc(buf),size:buf.length}}

async function g77ZnStart(o={}){if(G77_ZONES.busy){toast('צילומי האזורים כבר רצים');return null}if(!o.auto&&(G77_OT.lock||PERF.busy)){toast('בדיקה אחרת רצה');return null}

  const t=new Date();R={v:1,id:Date.now(),build:BUILD,lv:P.lv,at:t.toISOString(),stamp:g77OtStamp(t),plan:P,done:false,n:0,bytes:0,fails:[],slow:[],auto:!!o.auto,ms:0,settleMs:0};await g77ZnClearOther(R.id)}

 State.mapQa=true;State.paused=true;try{Input.held.clear()}catch(e){}
 const have=new Set(((await g77ZnKeys())||[]).map(String)),t0=performance.now();let i=0;
 try{for(const s of R.plan.shots){i++;if(G77_ZONES.abort)break;const key=R.id+'|'+s.n;if(have.has(key))continue;
   const st=await g77ZnSettle(s);R.settleMs+=st.ms;let out=null;try{out=await g77ZnShot(s,R)}catch(e){R.fails.push(s.n+': '+e.message);continue}
   if(!st.ok)R.slow.push(s.n);const ok=await g77ZnPut(key,{n:s.n,blob:out.blob,crc:out.crc,size:out.size,ms:st.ms,ok:st.ok});
   if(ok===null){R.fails.push(s.n+': השמירה בדפדפן נכשלה');if(R.fails.length>5){G77_ZONES.abort=true;break}continue}
   R.n++;R.bytes+=out.size;if(R.n%5===0)g77ZnSave(R);g77ZnProgress(R,i,performance.now()-t0)}}
 finally{R.ms+=Math.round(performance.now()-t0);State.paused=sv.pa;State.mapQa=sv.mq;
  if(!sv.mq){try{const a=playerActor();Camera.x=a.x;Camera.y=a.y}catch(e){Camera.x=sv.x;Camera.y=sv.y}}else{Camera.x=sv.x;Camera.y=sv.y}Camera.zoom=sv.z;
  try{G77_ASV.on=sv.asv;g77AsvReset()}catch(e){}try{G77_WL.hold=false;g77WakeOff()}catch(e){}G77_OT.lock=false;G77_ZONES.busy=false}
 let fp1=null;try{fp1=await g77OtFp()}catch(e){}R.savesKept=fp0&&fp1?Object.keys(fp0).every(k=>fp0[k]===fp1[k]):null;R.done=!G77_ZONES.abort;R.endAt=new Date().toISOString();g77ZnSave(R);
 await g77ZnEnd(R);return R}

function g77ZnZip(files){const enc=new TextEncoder(),out=[],cd=[],d=new Date();let off=0;const dt=((d.getFullYear()-1980)<<9)|((d.getMonth()+1)<<5)|d.getDate(),tm=(d.getHours()<<11)|(d.getMinutes()<<5)|(d.getSeconds()>>1);
 for(const f of files){const nm=enc.encode(f.name),h=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(30));h.setUint32(0,0x04034b50,true);h.setUint16(4,20,true);h.setUint16(6,0x0800,true);h.setUint16(8,0,true);h.setUint16(10,tm,true);h.setUint16(12,dt,true);
  h.setUint32(14,f.crc,true);h.setUint32(18,f.size,true);h.setUint32(22,f.size,true);h.setUint16(26,nm.length,true);h.setUint16(28,0,true);out.push(h.buffer,nm,f.blob);
  const c=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(46));c.setUint32(0,0x02014b50,true);c.setUint16(4,20,true);c.setUint16(6,20,true);c.setUint16(8,0x0800,true);c.setUint16(10,0,true);c.setUint16(12,tm,true);c.setUint16(14,dt,true);
  c.setUint32(16,f.crc,true);c.setUint32(20,f.size,true);c.setUint32(24,f.size,true);c.setUint16(28,nm.length,true);c.setUint32(42,off,true);cd.push(c.buffer,nm);off+=30+nm.length+f.size}
 let cl=0;for(const x of cd)cl+=x.byteLength;const e=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(22));e.setUint32(0,0x06054b50,true);e.setUint16(8,files.length,true);e.setUint16(10,files.length,true);e.setUint32(12,cl,true);e.setUint32(16,off,true);
 return new Blob(out.concat(cd,[e.buffer]),{type:'application/zip'})}

function g77PoleBest(x,y,occ,acc=false,gap=20,ns=false){    const E=EDGES,n=E.length,lb=new Float64Array(n),ix=new Array(n),W=g77Bw();W.refit++;

  if(L2>1e-9){let u=((x-a.x)*dx+(y-a.y)*dy)/L2;u=u<0?0:u>1?1:u;d=Math.hypot(x-(a.x+dx*u),y-(a.y+dy*u))-Math.abs(_ROAD_HALF(e)+10)}
  lb[i]=d>-Infinity?d:-Infinity;ix[i]=i}
 ix.sort((p,q)=>(lb[p]-lb[q])||(p-q));let best=null,bi=-1;
 for(const i of ix){if(best&&lb[i]-1e-6>best.d)break;W.roads++;const e=E[i],a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],len=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y),along=Math.max(8,Math.min(len-8,((x-a.x)*(b.x-a.x)+(y-a.y)*(b.y-a.y))/len));
  for(const sg of[-1,1]){const p=clearCurbPoint(e,along,sg,occ,acc,gap,ns);if(p){const d=Math.hypot(p.x-x,p.y-y);if(!best||d<best.d||(d===best.d&&i<bi)){best={...p,d};bi=i}}}}
 return best}

 if(bay.row2||bay.id==='F2-AB2'){const hx=D.fp[2]/2,sg=Math.sign(dy)||1,out=[door[0]-sn*sg*6,door[1]+c*sg*6],gy=((G77_YARD.busYc+hx)+(G77_YARD.row2Yc-hx))/2,wx=G77_YARD.x0+4;   
  return[door,out,[out[0],gy],[wx,gy],[wx,G2_GATE.walkY],[G2_GATE.door[0],G2_GATE.walkY],[G2_GATE.door[0],G2_GATE.door[1]]]}
 return[door,[g77WalkX(bay),door[1]],[g77WalkX(bay),G2_GATE.walkY],[G2_GATE.door[0],G2_GATE.walkY],[G2_GATE.door[0],G2_GATE.door[1]]]}
function g2GateDur(bay,n){return G2_WALK.pre+g2PathLen(g2GatePath(bay))/G2_WALK.v+(n-1)*G2_WALK.gap+G2_WALK.post}

const g2SOut=(b,vm)=>{const m=apttVehMove([[b.x-40,AF.L],[b.x,AF.L],[b.x,b.yc]],[18],vm*.45,{rev:true,v0:3,v1:4});m.kind='out';return m};
const g2SHome=b=>b.row2?[[AF.GLN,AF.HW,50],[AF.GLN,b.yc,16],[b.x,b.yc,0]]:[[AF.GLN,AF.HW,50],[AF.GLN,AF.L,22],[b.x,AF.L,18],[b.x,b.yc,0]];       
const g2Out0=b=>b.row2?[[AF.GLN,b.yc+16,0],[AF.GLN,AF.L,18],[AF.GLS,AF.L,18],[AF.GLS,AF.HE,22]]:[[b.x-40,AF.L,0],[AF.GLS,AF.L,22],[AF.GLS,AF.HE,22]];   
function g2RemoteBuild(v,sd,ac,kind,hold,meta){
 const b=v.bay,vm=AF.VMAX[v.type],R=G2_REM[sd.id],door=g2Door(sd,ac),tag=(leg,g2)=>{leg.g2=g2;return leg};
 const base={kind,stand:sd.id,code:meta&&meta.code||null,ac,door};
 const home=[b.x,b.yc,b.th,0,1],gateN=meta&&meta.n||0,hG=b.pocket==='MS'?0:g2GateDur(b,gateN);
 const legs=[];
 if(kind==='bus-dep'){const l=tag(apttHold(home,hG,'svc'),{...base,at:'gate',gate:'load',n:gateN});legs.push(l)}   
 if(b.pocket!=='MS'&&!b.row2)legs.push(g2SOut(b,vm));if(b.row2){const m=apttVehMove([[AF.GLN,b.yc+16],[AF.GLN,b.yc],[b.x,b.yc]],[16],vm*.45,{rev:true,v0:3,v1:4});m.kind='out';legs.push(m)}       
 let e=legs.length&&legs[legs.length-1].endPose?legs[legs.length-1].endPose():home,dOut=0,clear=0;   
 const fwd=(list,o={})=>{const m=afMv(list,vm,{th0:e[2],blend:o.blend??28,v0:o.v0??5,v1:o.v1??4});m.kind=o.kind||'out';legs.push(tag(m,base));e=m.endPose();return m};
 const rev=(list,f=.45)=>{const {pts,rad}=afPL(list);const m=apttVehMove(pts,rad,vm*f,{rev:true,v0:3,v1:3});m.kind='back';legs.push(tag(m,base));e=m.endPose();return m};
 const turn=(dir)=>{const p=e.slice(),th0=p[2];const l={kind:'turn',dur:AF.PIV,pose:t=>[p[0],p[1],th0+Math.PI/2*dir*apttSm(t/AF.PIV),0,1]};legs.push(tag(l,base));e=l.pose(AF.PIV);return l};
 const svc=()=>{const h=tag(apttHold(e,hold,'svc'),{...base,at:'ac'});legs.push(h);return h};
 if((kind==='stairs'||kind==='stairs2')&&b.pocket==='MS'&&(sd.id==='P5'||g2UsesTruck(sd,ac))){   
  const K=G2_STAIR_PARK,dr=kind==='stairs2'?g2Door2(sd,ac):door,sx=dr[0]+G2_STAIR_GAP+32,y=dr[1];base.door=dr;
  if(sd.id==='P5'){const cA=7791,yF=862,cC=8040,yL=790;
   fwd([[b.x,b.yc,0],[K.exitX,b.yc,16],[K.exitX,yF,14],[cA,yF,18],[cA,y,16],[sx,y,0]]);dOut=legs.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.dur,0);svc();
   rev([[cA,y],[sx,y]]);clear=legs[legs.length-1].dur;turn(-1);
   fwd([[cA,y,0],[cA,yF,16],[cC,yF,18],[cC,yL,16],[K.entryX,yL,16],[K.entryX,b.yc,16],[b.x,b.yc,0]],{kind:'back',v0:4});
  }else{const cC=8040,yL=790;
   fwd([[b.x,b.yc,0],[K.exitX,b.yc,16],[K.exitX,yL,16],[cC,yL,16],[cC,y,16],[sx,y,0]]);dOut=legs.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.dur,0);svc();
   rev([[cC,y],[sx,y]]);clear=legs[legs.length-1].dur;turn(-1);
   fwd([[cC,y,0],[cC,yL,16],[K.entryX,yL,16],[K.entryX,b.yc,16],[b.x,b.yc,0]],{kind:'back',v0:4});
  }
 }else if(kind==='stairs'){
  const sx=door[0]+G2_STAIR_GAP+32,y=door[1];
  if(R.via==='EAST'&&b.pocket==='MS'){
   const K=G2_STAIR_PARK;
   fwd([[b.x,b.yc,0],[K.exitX,b.yc,16],[K.exitX,y,16],[sx,y,0]]);dOut=legs.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.dur,0);svc();
   rev([[R.pivotX,y],[sx,y]]);clear=legs[legs.length-1].dur;turn(2);
   fwd([[R.pivotX,y,0],[K.entryX,y,16],[K.entryX,b.yc,16],[b.x,b.yc,0]],{kind:'back',v0:4});
  }else throw new Error('G2 stairs: P6 from the stair park only');
 }else{
  if(R.via==='EAST'){
   fwd([...g2Out0(b),[R.xN,AF.HE,16],[R.xN,R.uy,16],[R.ux,R.uy,24],[R.ux,R.busY,24],[R.busX,R.busY,0]]);dOut=legs.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.dur,0);svc();
   const c1=fwd([[R.busX,R.busY,0],[8150,R.busY,12],[8150,R.uy,12],[R.xS,R.uy,16],[R.xS,1060,0]],{kind:'back',v0:4});clear=c1.dur;   
   fwd([[R.xS,1060,0],[R.xS,AF.HW,16],...g2SHome(b)],{kind:'back',v0:6});
  }else{
   fwd([...g2Out0(b),[R.x,AF.HE,16],[R.x,R.busY,0]]);dOut=legs.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.dur,0);svc();
   const c1=rev([[R.x,AF.HE],[R.x,R.busY]]);clear=c1.dur;
   fwd([[R.x,AF.HE,0],[R.x,AF.HW,14],...g2SHome(b)],{kind:'back',v0:4});
  }
 }
 if(kind==='bus-arr'){const l=tag(apttHold(home,hG,'svc'),{...base,at:'gate',gate:'unload',n:gateN});legs.push(l)}   
 const trk=afTrackOf(v,legs);trk.g2=kind;trk.gateHold=hG;
 return{trk,dOut,hold,clear,dur:trk.seq.dur,gate:hG};
}

function* g2ServeG(kind,sd,ac,win,hold,meta,extra){
 const type=kind==='stairs'||kind==='stairs2'?'MS':'AB';let best=null;
 for(const v of afCands(type,3)){if(type==='AB'&&v.bay&&v.bay.id==='F2-AB1')continue;    
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0;
  const B=g2RemoteBuild(v,sd,ac,kind,hold,meta),sm=(yield* aoSampG(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq)));
  const sLo=Math.max(aoSlUp(win.at0-B.dOut),afSEarliest());
  let sHi=aoSl(win.at1-B.dOut);if(win.clearBy!=null)sHi=Math.min(sHi,Math.floor((win.clearBy-B.dOut-hold-B.clear)/AO.DT));
  if(best)sHi=Math.min(sHi,best.s-1);
  const s=sHi>=sLo?(yield* afSearchG(v,B.trk,sm,sLo,sHi,extra,Math.round((B.dOut+hold+16)/AO.DT))):-1;
  if(s<0){const w=aoWhy(sm,sLo);const key='remote-'+kind+':'+(w?w.b.replace(/\d+/g,'#'):'busy/none');AF.fails[key]=(AF.fails[key]||0)+1;continue}
  if(!best||s<best.s)best={v,B,sm,s};
 }
 if(!best){AF.stats.fail++;return null}
 const at=aoT(best.s)+best.B.dOut,task=afCommit(best.v,best.B.trk,best.sm,best.s,'remote-'+kind,{code:meta&&meta.code,stand:sd.id,at});
 return{t0:task.t0,end:task.t1,at,done:at+hold,clear:best.B.clear,v:best.v,task,gate:best.B.gate||0};
}

function* g2RemoteServicesG(sd,ac,tOB,dwell,meta,extra){const m0=AO.LOG.length;for(const ex of [0,150,300]){if(ex)aoRoll(m0);const r=yield* g2RemoteServices1G(sd,ac,tOB,dwell,meta,extra,ex);if(r){if(ex)AO.stats.g2Ext=(AO.stats.g2Ext||0)+1;return r}}return null}
function* g2RemoteServices1G(sd,ac,tOB,dwell,meta,extra,ex){
 const truck=g2UsesTruck(sd,ac),nA=g2PaxN(meta.code,'arr',ac),nD=g2PaxN(meta.code,'dep',ac),hA=g2BoardDur(sd,ac,nA),hD=g2BoardDur(sd,ac,nD);
 let st=null,st2=null,winEnd;
 if(truck){
  const Hs=Math.max(dwell-20,hA+hD+190)+(ex||0);
  st=yield* g2ServeG('stairs',sd,ac,{at0:tOB+4+G77_CHOCK,at1:tOB+70+G77_CHOCK},Hs,meta,extra);if(!st)return null;
  winEnd=st.done-2;
  if(g2Rear(sd,ac)){st2=yield* g2ServeG('stairs2',sd,ac,{at0:st.at+6,at1:st.at+70},Hs,meta,extra);if(!st2)return null;winEnd=Math.min(winEnd,st2.done-2)}   
 }
 const ba=yield* g2ServeG('bus-arr',sd,ac,{at0:(st2?Math.max(st.at,st2.at):st?st.at:tOB+G77_CHOCK)+5,at1:(st2?Math.max(st.at,st2.at):st?st.at:tOB+G77_CHOCK)+95,clearBy:st?st.done-hD-60:null},hA,{...meta,n:nA},extra);if(!ba)return null;
 
 const depLo=ba.done+ba.clear+25,depHi=st?winEnd:tOB+dwell+120,want=Math.max(depLo,(st?st.done-hD-55:tOB+dwell-hD-30));
 let bd=null;
 if(want>depLo+8)bd=yield* g2ServeG('bus-dep',sd,ac,{at0:want,at1:Math.max(want,depHi),clearBy:st?winEnd:null},hD,{...meta,n:nD},extra);
 if(!bd)bd=yield* g2ServeG('bus-dep',sd,ac,{at0:depLo,at1:Math.max(depLo,depHi),clearBy:st?winEnd:null},hD,{...meta,n:nD},extra);
 if(!bd)return null;
 const end=Math.max(st?st.done+st.clear+6:0,st2?st2.done+st2.clear+6:0,bd.done+bd.clear+4);
 
 const gateArr={v:ba.v.id,bay:ba.v.bay.id,at:ba.end-ba.gate,done:ba.end,n:nA},gateDep={v:bd.v.id,bay:bd.v.bay.id,at:bd.t0,done:bd.t0+bd.gate,n:nD};
 return{end,plan:{stand:sd.id,ac,truck,door:g2Door(sd,ac),path:g2PaxPath(sd,ac),stairs:st&&{v:st.v.id,at:st.at,done:st.done},stairs2:st2&&{v:st2.v.id,at:st2.at,done:st2.done},door2:st2?g2Door2(sd,ac):null,path2:st2?g2PaxPath2(sd,ac):null,arr:{v:ba.v.id,at:ba.at,done:ba.done,n:nA},dep:{v:bd.v.id,at:bd.at,done:bd.done,n:nD},gateArr,gateDep,open:(st?st.at:ba.at-6),close:(st?st.done:bd.done+6)}};
}

const G2_PAX_ASSETS=['PE-43','PE-44','PE-09','PE-10','PE-19','PE-04','PE-40','PE-41'];
function g2RemotePassengers(t=APT_OPS.clk,flights=AO.flights){
 const out=[];
 for(const f of flights){const r=f.g2;if(!r)continue;const tA=Math.min(r.open,r.gateDep?r.gateDep.at:1e9),tB=Math.max(r.close,r.gateArr?r.gateArr.done:-1e9);if(t<tA-1||t>tB+1)continue;
  for(const ph of['arr','dep','gateArr','gateDep']){const w=r[ph];if(!w||t<w.at||t>w.done)continue;
   const gate=ph==='gateArr'||ph==='gateDep',two=!gate&&!!r.path2;
   for(let i=0;i<w.n;i++){const P=gate?g2GatePath(APL.bays.find(b=>b.id===w.bay)):two&&i%2?r.path2:r.path,L=g2PathLen(P),pts=(ph==='arr'||ph==='gateArr')?P:P.slice().reverse(),travel=L/G2_WALK.v;   
    const lt=t-w.at-G2_WALK.pre-(two?i>>1:i)*G2_WALK.gap;if(lt<0||lt>=travel)continue;let d=lt*G2_WALK.v,k=1;
    while(k<pts.length-1&&d>Math.hypot(pts[k][0]-pts[k-1][0],pts[k][1]-pts[k-1][1])){d-=Math.hypot(pts[k][0]-pts[k-1][0],pts[k][1]-pts[k-1][1]);k++}
    const a=pts[k-1],b=pts[k],sl=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])||1,u=Math.min(1,d/sl),dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1];
    out.push({id:f.code+'-'+ph+'-'+i,flight:f.code,stand:f.stand,phase:ph,gate,asset:G2_PAX_ASSETS[(i+g2Hash(f.code))%G2_PAX_ASSETS.length],x:a[0]+dx*u,y:a[1]+dy*u,face:Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?(dx>0?2:6):(dy>0?4:0),walkTime:lt+i*.21,alpha:Math.min(1,lt*3,(travel-lt)*3)})}
  }
 }
 return out;
}
function g2DrawAirstair(g,x,y,al){ 
 g.save();g.globalAlpha=al;g.fillStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.22)';g.fillRect(x+1,y-3,17,8);g.fillStyle='#d8dde2';g.fillRect(x,y-4,16,8);g.strokeStyle='#6b747c';g.lineWidth=.8;
 for(let sx=x+2;sx<x+16;sx+=2.6){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(sx,y-3.4);g.lineTo(sx,y+3.4);g.stroke()}g.fillStyle='#e07a2a';g.fillRect(x,y-4.4,16,1);g.fillRect(x,y+3.4,16,1);g.restore();
}
function g2DrawRemote(now,v){if(WTC_LP===1)return;
 if(!APT_OPS.ready||!(portVis(v,7600,700,800,260)||portVis(v,6870,614,140,170)))return;const t=APT_OPS.clk;
 for(const f of AO.flights){const r=f.g2;if(!r||t<r.open||t>r.close)continue;const d=r.door;
  if(!r.truck)g2DrawAirstair(ctx,d[0],d[1],Math.min(1,(t-r.open)/2,(r.close-t)/2));
  else{ 
   const S=AO.fleet.find(q=>q.id===r.stairs.v);const p=S&&afPose(S,t);const lg=p&&p.task?p.task.tr.seq.legAt(t-p.task.t0):null;
   if(lg&&lg.leg.kind==='svc'){ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#9aa3ab';ctx.fillRect(d[0]-1,d[1]-4,G2_STAIR_GAP+2,8);ctx.fillStyle='#e3bf3e';ctx.fillRect(d[0]-1,d[1]-4.6,G2_STAIR_GAP+2,1.2);ctx.restore()}
   if(r.stairs2&&r.door2){const S2=AO.fleet.find(q=>q.id===r.stairs2.v),p2=S2&&afPose(S2,t),l2=p2&&p2.task?p2.task.tr.seq.legAt(t-p2.task.t0):null,d2=r.door2;if(l2&&l2.leg.kind==='svc'){ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#9aa3ab';ctx.fillRect(d2[0]-1,d2[1]-4,G2_STAIR_GAP+2,8);ctx.fillStyle='#e3bf3e';ctx.fillRect(d2[0]-1,d2[1]-4.6,G2_STAIR_GAP+2,1.2);ctx.restore()}}
  }
 }
 for(const p of g2RemotePassengers(t)){if(!portVis(v,p.x-12,p.y-20,24,30))continue;const I=TurboCity.info(p.asset,{scale:G77_PE.sc,direction:p.face,pose:'walking'}),feet=I.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Feet')||['Feet',I.w/2,I.h*.55];
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=p.alpha;P34G.k=p.id??null;TurboCity.draw(ctx,p.asset,p.x-feet[1],p.y-feet[2],{mode:'runtime',scale:G77_PE.sc,direction:p.face,pose:'walking',time:p.walkTime});ctx.restore()}
}

function g2RemoteStats(T){
 const all=AO.hist.concat(AO.flights).filter(f=>(f.stand==='P6'||f.stand==='P5')&&!f.never&&!f.heli),issues=[];let visits=0,served=0,pax=0,trucks=0;
 const tasks=[];for(const v of AO.fleet)for(const k of v.hist.concat(v.tasks))if(String(k.role).startsWith('remote-'))tasks.push({v:v.id,role:k.role,code:k.code,t0:k.t0,t1:k.t1,at:k.at});
 for(const f of all){if(!G2_REMOTE_AC.has(f.ac)||f.states?.[0]?.[1]!=='INBOUND')continue;if(f.tOB==null||f.tOB>T)continue;visits++;const r=f.g2;if(!r){issues.push(f.code+':no-remote-plan');continue}served++;
  if(r.truck){trucks++;if(!(r.stairs.at<r.arr.at&&r.dep.done<r.stairs.done))issues.push(f.code+':stairs-window');if(r.stairs2){trucks++;if(!(r.stairs2.at<r.arr.at&&r.dep.done<r.stairs2.done))issues.push(f.code+':rear-stairs-window')}}
  if(!(r.arr.at>=f.tOB&&r.arr.done<r.dep.at))issues.push(f.code+':bus-order');
  if(f.tPush!=null&&r.close>f.tPush+.5)issues.push(f.code+':open-at-push');pax+=r.arr.n+r.dep.n;
  const mine=tasks.filter(k=>k.code===f.code);if(mine.length!==(r.truck?(r.stairs2?4:3):2))issues.push(f.code+':task-count '+mine.length)}
 const shuttles=tasks.filter(k=>/remote-bus/.test(k.role)&&k.t0<=T).length,stairsUses=tasks.filter(k=>/remote-stairs/.test(k.role)&&k.t0<=T).length;   
 return{ok:issues.length===0,visits,served,trucks,pax,tasks:tasks.length,shuttles,stairsUses,issues};
}

const G2_FLEET_LABELS={PT:'גוררי Pushback',BT:'רכבות מזוודות',FT:'מכליות דלק',SH:'הסעות צוות',SVC:'רכבי שירות',MX:'גרר תחזוקה',ARFF:'כבאות והצלה',EMS:'אמבולנסים',POL:'משטרת השדה',AB:'אוטובוסי רחבה',MS:'מדרגות ניידות'};
function g2FleetStatus(t=APT_OPS.clk){
 if(!APT_OPS.ready)return null;const by={};let busy=0;
 for(const v of AO.fleet){const p=afPose(v,t),b=by[v.type]||(by[v.type]={n:0,busy:0});b.n++;if(p&&p.task){b.busy++;busy++}}
 return{total:AO.fleet.length,busy,home:AO.fleet.length-busy,by};
}
function g2StandStatus(id,t=APT_OPS.clk){
 if(!APT_OPS.ready)return 'הפעילות בשדה עדיין נטענת';
 const f=AO.flights.find(q=>q.stand===id&&!q.heli&&!q.never&&q.states?.some(s=>s[1]==='ON_BLOCK'||s[1]==='INBOUND'));
 if(!f)return 'פנויה';const r=f.g2,s=aoStateOf(f,t);
 if(r&&r.gateArr&&t>=r.gateArr.at&&t<=r.gateArr.done)return f.code+' · הנוסעים יורדים מהאוטובוס בשער T3';
 if(r&&r.gateDep&&t>=r.gateDep.at&&t<=r.gateDep.done)return f.code+' · הנוסעים עולים לאוטובוס בשער T3';
 if(r&&t>=r.open&&t<=r.close){const ph=t<r.arr.done?'ירידת נוסעים לאוטובוס':t<r.dep.at?'האוטובוס בדרך לטרמינל':t<=r.dep.done?'עליית נוסעים מהאוטובוס':'סגירת דלת';return f.code+' · '+ph+(r.truck?' · מדרגות ניידות':'')}
 return f.code+' · '+(E2_STATE_LABELS[s]||s||'בדרך');
}

function g2GeometryAudit(){
 const A=aptReady(),issues=[],over=aptOver,inside=q=>q.x>=7200-.01&&q.y>=850-.01&&q.x+q.w<=8400+.01&&q.y+q.h<=1700+.01;
 const roads=aptRoadRects(),fps=APT_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp);
 for(const q of[...G2_STALLS,...G2_SHUTTLE_SPACES,...G2_PROPS.map(f2SpriteBox),...G2_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp),G2_LOT,G2_PLATFORM])if(!inside(q))issues.push('outside-G2:'+(q.id||q.x));
 
 const lots=[{id:'lot',...G2_LOT},{id:'AW',x:G2_AW.x,y:1318,w:G2_AW.w,h:58},{id:'AE',x:G2_AE.x,y:1318,w:G2_AE.w,h:58},{id:'staff',x:7800,y:1376,w:68,h:316}];
 for(const L of lots){for(const r of roads)if(over(L,r))issues.push('lot-on-road:'+L.id+'/'+r.id);for(const f of fps)if(over(L,f))issues.push('lot-under-building:'+L.id+'/'+f.id);if(over(L,{x:7869,y:1150,w:531,h:550}))issues.push('lot-in-yard:'+L.id)}
 for(let i=0;i<G2_STALLS.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<G2_STALLS.length;j++)if(over(G2_STALLS[i],G2_STALLS[j]))issues.push('stall-overlap:'+G2_STALLS[i].id+'/'+G2_STALLS[j].id);
 const walk={x:G2_FOOT.x,y:G2_FOOT.y,w:G2_FOOT.w,h:G2_FOOT.y1-G2_FOOT.y};
 for(const s of G2_STALLS){for(const a of G2_AISLES)if(over(s,a))issues.push('stall-in-aisle:'+s.id);if(over(s,walk))issues.push('stall-on-walkway:'+s.id);for(const h of G2_HEDGES)if(over(s,h))issues.push('stall-on-hedge:'+s.id)}
 
 for(const s of G2_STALLS){if(s.staff){if(s.x!==G2_AE.x+G2_AE.w)issues.push('staff-access:'+s.id);continue}const a=s.row==='R3'?G2_AISLES[1]:G2_AISLES[0];if(!(s.y+s.h===a.y||s.y===a.y+a.h))issues.push('aisle-access:'+s.id)}
 
 for(const c of PARKED_CARS.filter(c=>/^PC-G2-/.test(c.id))){const I=TurboCity.info(c.asset,{scale:roadVehicleScaleFor(c.asset,c.ref)}),r=c.slotRect,vert=Math.abs(Math.sin(c.heading||0))>.5,len=I.w-4,wid=I.h-4;if(!r)continue;if(vert?(wid>r.w+1||len>r.h+1):(len>r.w+1||wid>r.h+1))issues.push('car-clearance:'+c.id)}
 
 const Lb=G2_SHUTTLE_LAYBY,lay={id:'layby',x:Lb.x0,y:Lb.y0,w:Lb.x1-Lb.x0,h:Lb.y1-Lb.y0};
 if(Lb.y0<1298||Lb.y1>1346)issues.push('layby-band');for(const c of G2_CUTS.slice(0,2))if(over(lay,c))issues.push('layby-on-driveway:'+c.id);
 
 const blockers=[...G2_STALLS,...G2_AISLES,lay,...G2_CUTS,{id:'AW',x:G2_AW.x,y:1318,w:G2_AW.w,h:58},{id:'AE',x:G2_AE.x,y:1318,w:G2_AE.w,h:58},walk];
 for(const o of G2_PROPS){const q=f2SpriteBox(o);for(const b of blockers)if(over(q,b)&&!(o.id==='G2-GATE-BARRIER'&&b.id==='G2-GATE-LANE'))issues.push(o.id+':blocks '+(b.id||'area'));if(q.y<1318&&o.id!=='G2-GATE-BARRIER'&&o.id!=='G2-GATE-STOP')issues.push(o.id+':in-road-band')}
 for(const o of[...G2_TREES,...G2_LAMPS]){const q={x:o.x-6,y:o.y-6,w:12,h:12};for(const r of roads)if(over(q,r))issues.push(o.id+':on-road');for(const b of blockers)if(over(q,b))issues.push(o.id+':blocks '+(b.id||'area'))}
 for(const l of STREET_LIGHTS.filter(l=>l.x>=7200&&l.x<7880&&l.y>1140&&l.y<1700)){const q={x:l.x-5,y:l.y-5,w:10,h:10};for(const b of blockers)if(over(q,b))issues.push(l.id+':blocks '+(b.id||'area'))}
 for(const id of['APT-LONG','APT-LONG-STOP','APT-STAFF-GATE']){const p=APT_INTERACTIONS[id];if(personBlockedAt(p.x,p.y,5))issues.push(id+':blocked-poi')}
 
 const lk=G2_CUTS.find(c=>c.id==='G2-F2-LINK');
 if(!(lk.y>=F2_A3.y&&lk.y+lk.h<=F2_A3.y+F2_A3.h&&lk.y===G2_AISLES[0].y&&lk.h===G2_AISLES[0].h&&lk.x<=F2_A3.x+F2_A3.w&&lk.x+lk.w>=G2_AW.x))issues.push('f2-link-alignment');
 for(const o of[...F2_PROPS.map(f2SpriteBox),...[...F2_TREES,...F2_LAMPS,...G2_TREES,...G2_LAMPS,...STREET_LIGHTS].map(o=>({id:o.id,x:o.x-6,y:o.y-6,w:12,h:12}))])if(over(o,lk))issues.push('f2-link-blocked:'+o.id);
 
 for(const id of['P6','P5']){const s=A.stands.find(q=>q.id===id);if(!s||!s.remote||s.kind!=='pax')issues.push(id+':not-remote-pax')}
 const ab=A.bays.filter(b=>b.kind==='AB'),ms=A.bays.filter(b=>b.kind==='MS');
 if(ab.length!==G2_S_BAYS.length||ab.some(b=>!G2_S_BAYS.some(q=>q.id===b.id&&q.x===b.x)))issues.push('apron-bus-bays');   
 for(const v of A.fleet.filter(f=>f.type==='AB'||f.type==='MS')){const b=A.bays.find(q=>q.id===v.bay);if(!b||b.kind!==v.type)issues.push('home:'+v.id)}
 if(A.bays.filter(b=>b.zone!=='F2').length<24)issues.push('ground-ops-bays<24');
 const lotStalls=G2_STALLS.filter(s=>!s.staff).length,total=APT_STALLS.length+F2_STALLS.length+G2_STALLS.length;
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,30),scope:'G2',gate:'GATE-69',parking:{lot:lotStalls,staff:G2_STALLS.length-lotStalls,accessible:G2_STALLS.filter(s=>s.accessible).length,ev:G2_STALLS.filter(s=>s.ev).length,airportTotal:total,parked:PARKED_CARS.filter(c=>/^PC-G2-/.test(c.id)).length},
  shuttle:G2_SHUTTLE_SPACES.length,props:G2_PROPS.length,trees:G2_TREES.length,lamps:G2_LAMPS.length,remote:{stands:['P6','P5'],aircraft:[...G2_REMOTE_AC],apronBuses:ab.map(b=>b.id),stairs:ms.map(b=>b.id)},yardBays:A.bays.filter(b=>b.zone!=='F2').length,fleet:A.fleet.length,next:'AIRPORT-FINISH'}
}
function g2OpsQa(minutes=20,seed=777){
 if(!APTT_SPEC){APTT_SPEC=aptBuildSpec();APTT_C=aptBuildC()}
 return aoSandbox(()=>{AO.keep=true;aoInit(0,seed);const T=minutes*60;let paxSeen=0,maxPax=0;
  for(let t=0;t<=T;t+=1){aoStep(t);if(t%5===0){const n=g2RemotePassengers(t).length;if(n)paxSeen++;maxPax=Math.max(maxPax,n)}}
  const v=aoVerify(0,T),rem=g2RemoteStats(T),all=AO.hist.concat(AO.flights);
  const dep=all.filter(f=>f.states.some(s=>s[1]==='DEPARTED')&&!f.init).length,arr=all.filter(f=>f.states.some(s=>s[1]==='ON_BLOCK')&&f.states[0][1]==='INBOUND').length;
  return{ok:v.ok&&rem.ok,seed,minutes,verify:{ok:v.ok,issues:v.issues.slice(0,6)},dep,arr,remote:rem,paxSamples:paxSeen,maxPax};
 });
}

function airport4Tick(bus,dt,parked){
 if(bus.line!==4)return false;
 const m=bus.airport4;
 if(!m){if(bus.edgeId!=='F2-AIR-S'||bus.dirSign!==1||bus.turn||bus.t<AIRPORT4.entryT-.0008)return false;
  bus.speed=0;bus.wait=true;AIRPORT4.holdN=true;AIRPORT4.holdSeen=BUS_CLOCK.t;
  if(AIRPORT4.owner&&AIRPORT4.owner!==bus.id)return true;
  if(!airport4RoadClear(bus))return true;
  const p=termPose(AIRPORT4.entry,0);if(!airport4BodyClear(bus,p))return true;
  AIRPORT4.owner=bus.id;bus.airport4={phase:'in',s:0,v:0,dwell:0,reverse:false};bus.plan=null;bus.turn=null;bus.curbStop=null;return true;
 }
 if(m.phase==='dwell'){AIRPORT4.holdN=false;bus.speed=0;bus.wait=true;m.dwell-=dt;if(m.dwell<=0){m.phase='reverse';m.s=0;m.v=0;}return true;}
 const path=m.phase==='in'?AIRPORT4.entry:m.phase==='reverse'?AIRPORT4.reverse:AIRPORT4.exit;
 const left=Math.max(0,path.total-m.s);m.v=Math.min(m.v+28*dt,m.phase==='reverse'?12:22,Math.sqrt(2*35*left)+1);const ns=Math.min(path.total,m.s+m.v*dt),p=termPose(path,ns);if(m.phase==='reverse')p.heading+=Math.PI;
 if(m.phase==='out'&&m.s>path.total-130){AIRPORT4.holdN=true;AIRPORT4.holdSeen=BUS_CLOCK.t;if(!m.committed&&!airport4RoadClear(bus)){bus.speed=0;bus.wait=true;m.v=0;return true;}m.committed=true;}
 if(!airport4BodyClear(bus,p)){bus.speed=0;bus.wait=true;m.v=0;return true;}
 m.s=ns;bus.x=p.x;bus.y=p.y;bus.heading=p.heading;bus.speed=m.v;bus.wait=false;
 if(ns>=path.total-.01){
  if(m.phase==='in'){m.phase='dwell';m.s=0;m.v=0;bus.speed=0;const ex=exchangeBusPassengers(bus,AIRPORT4_PLAT_STOP,{final:true});spawnBusAlighters(bus,AIRPORT4_PLAT_STOP,ex.alight);m.dwell=9+ex.board*.3+ex.alight*.2;AIRPORT4.visits++;}
  else if(m.phase==='reverse'){m.phase='out';m.s=0;m.v=0;}
  else{bus.airport4=null;AIRPORT4.owner=null;AIRPORT4.holdN=false;AIRPORT4.dispatches++;bus.routeIndex=BUS_LINE_4_ROUTE.findIndex(s=>s.edgeId==='F2-AIR-S'&&s.dirSign===-1);bus.edgeId='F2-AIR-S';bus.dirSign=-1;bus.t=AIRPORT4.mergeT;bus.lane=0;bus.plan=null;bus.turn=null;bus.stopCursor=nextBusStopCursor(4,bus.routeIndex,bus.t);bus.speed=12;bus.stuck=0;}
 }return true;
}

 for(const q of [...PWN_STALLS,...APT_STALLS,PWN_AISLE,PWN_WALK,PWN_KIOSK_SLOT])if(q.x<EW2_PWN.x||q.y<EW2_PWN.y||q.x+q.w>(q===PWN_AISLE?EW2_TRAIN_ACCESS.x:EW2_PWN.x+EW2_PWN.w)||q.y+q.h>EW2_PWN.y+EW2_PWN.h)issues.push('pwn-outside-reserve:'+q.id);

 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)],pad:[T.x,T.y,T.x+T.w,T.y+T.h],fenceY:EW2_FENCE_Y,towGate:[G.x0,G.x1],trainerSpan:+span.toFixed(1),hold:[H.x,H.y,H.x+H.w,H.y+H.h],pWestN:[EW2_PWN.x,EW2_PWN.y,EW2_PWN.x+EW2_PWN.w,EW2_PWN.y+EW2_PWN.h],jobs:EW2_JOB_IDS.length}}

 const typeOrder=['taxi','delivery','errand','route','bus','warehouse','logistics','other'],areaOrder=['B5','B2','C2','C3','D2','D3','B4','C4','D4','D5','E3','E4','E5','C6','E6','BUS','OTHER'],order=MISSION_VIEW_MODE==='type'?typeOrder:areaOrder;
 const groupHtml=[...groups.entries()].sort((a,b)=>{const ai=order.indexOf(a[0]),bi=order.indexOf(b[0]);return(ai<0?999:ai)-(bi<0?999:bi)}).map(([key,arr])=>`<section class="missionGroup"><div class="missionGroupHead"><b>${missionGroupLabel(key,MISSION_VIEW_MODE)}</b><span>${arr.length} עבודות · ${arr.filter(q=>licenseOwned(q.license)).length} זמינות</span></div>${arr.sort((a,b)=>Number(licenseOwned(b.license))-Number(licenseOwned(a.license))).map(missionCardHtml).join('')}</section>`).join('');
 const progress=pcard('התקדמות בעבודות',pkv([['הושלמו',n+' / '+defs.length],['מונית',PlayerProfile.progression.jobLevels.taxi||0],['משלוחים',PlayerProfile.progression.jobLevels.delivery||0],['שליחויות קלות',PlayerProfile.progression.jobLevels.errand||0],['סיורים ורב־תחנות',PlayerProfile.progression.jobLevels.route||0],['נהג אוטובוס',PlayerProfile.progression.jobLevels.bus||0],['מחסן / מלגזה',PlayerProfile.progression.jobLevels.warehouse||0],['לוגיסטיקה ונמל',PlayerProfile.progression.jobLevels.logistics||0]]),'missions');
 return active+switcher+groupHtml+progress
}

function fishingSpeciesFor(habitat){return habitat==='coastal'?COAST_FISH:LAKE_FISH}

const B6_TACKLE_ITEMS=[['b6-salt-line','חוט עמיד למי מלח',160],['b6-tackle-pouch','נרתיק ציוד חופי',125],['b6-rod-holder','מעמד חכה לחוף',110],['b6-fish-cooler','צידנית לדגים',240]];
for(const [id,b] of Object.entries(LAKE_BAITS))if(b.price&&!SHOP_CATALOG[id])SHOP_CATALOG[id]={name:b.label,price:b.price,store:'fishing',once:!!b.reusable,desc:b.desc};    
for(const [id,b] of Object.entries(COAST_BAITS)){SHOP_CATALOG[id]={name:b.label,price:b.price,store:'fishing',once:!!b.reusable,desc:b.desc};BAIT_LABELS[id]=b.label}

const b6ShopB=id=>B6_BUILDINGS.find(b=>b.id===id);
LOT_POIS.push(...['B6-TACKLE','B6-CAFE'].map(id=>({id,chunk:'B6',app:'beachShop',mode:'walk',...b6ShopB(id).entrance,r:52,label:b6ShopB(id).label,short:b6ShopB(id).label})));
function b6ShopAction(action,id=null){ensureEconomySchema();const shop=lotHeld(State.interactionId),f=ensureFishingSchema();if(!shop||!['B6-TACKLE','B6-CAFE'].includes(shop.id))return toast('צריך לעמוד בכניסה לחנות החוף וללחוץ F');
 if(action==='buy'){const it=SHOP_CATALOG[id],rod=rodItemLevel(id),allowed=shop.id==='B6-TACKLE'?(COAST_BAIT_IDS.includes(id)||id==='fish-license'||rod||B6_TACKLE_ITEMS.some(i=>i[0]===id)):B6_CAFE_ITEMS.some(i=>i[0]===id);if(!allowed||!it)return toast('הפריט אינו נמכר כאן');if(it.once&&(id==='fish-license'?licenseOwned('LIC-11'):rod?f.rodLevel>=rod:(PlayerProfile.inventory[id]||0)>0))return toast('הציוד כבר בבעלותך');if(rod>f.rodLevel+1)return toast('רכוש קודם חכה רמה '+(rod-1));if(PlayerProfile.money<it.price)return toast('אין מספיק כסף');const before=PlayerProfile.money;PlayerProfile.money-=it.price;if(rod)f.rodLevel=rod;else if(id==='fish-license'){PlayerProfile.licenses['LIC-11']={state:'owned',source:shop.id,acquiredAt:iso()};f.licenseState='owned'}else PlayerProfile.inventory[id]=(PlayerProfile.inventory[id]||0)+1;PlayerProfile.worldPersistent.purchases.push({id,shop:shop.id,price:it.price,balanceBefore:before,balanceAfter:PlayerProfile.money,at:iso()});recordTransaction('shop-purchase',-it.price,{item:id,shop:shop.id,balanceBefore:before});SaveManager.save('beach-buy',{backup:false,silent:true});toast('נרכש: '+it.name);renderPhone();return true}
 if(action==='sell'&&shop.id==='B6-TACKLE'){const candidates=f.inventory.filter(q=>COAST_FISH.some(s=>s.id===q.id)&&(!id||q.catchId===id));if(!candidates.length)return toast('אין דגי חוף למכירה');const ids=new Set(candidates.map(q=>q.catchId)),total=candidates.reduce((n,q)=>n+fishSellValue(q),0);f.inventory=f.inventory.filter(q=>!ids.has(q.catchId));PlayerProfile.money+=total;f.totalSold+=candidates.length;f.totalEarned+=total;recordTransaction('fish-sale',total,{count:candidates.length,shop:shop.id,catchIds:[...ids]});SaveManager.save('beach-fish-sale',{backup:false,silent:true});toast('נמכרו '+candidates.length+' דגי ים · '+money(total));renderPhone();return true}return false}
function phoneB6Shop(){const id=State.interactionId,held=!!lotHeld(id),f=ensureFishingSchema(),fishShop=id==='B6-TACKLE',items=fishShop?[...COAST_BAIT_IDS,'fish-license','rod-l2','rod-l3','rod-l4','rod-l5',...B6_TACKLE_ITEMS.map(i=>i[0])]:B6_CAFE_ITEMS.map(i=>i[0]);
 const rows=items.map(key=>{const it=SHOP_CATALOG[key],rod=rodItemLevel(key),owned=it.once&&(key==='fish-license'?licenseOwned('LIC-11'):rod?f.rodLevel>=rod:(PlayerProfile.inventory[key]||0)>0),disabled=!held||owned||rod>f.rodLevel+1||PlayerProfile.money<it.price;return `<div class="pc"><div class="pm"><span><b>${it.name}</b><small>${it.desc||'בתיק ×'+(PlayerProfile.inventory[key]||0)}</small></span><b>${money(it.price)}</b></div><button class="primary" data-b6-buy="${key}" ${disabled?'disabled':''}>${owned?'בבעלותך':rod>f.rodLevel+1?'נדרשת חכה קודמת':'קנה'}</button></div>`}).join('');
 const bag=f.inventory.filter(q=>COAST_FISH.some(s=>s.id===q.id)),value=bag.reduce((n,q)=>n+fishSellValue(q),0),priceGuide=fishShop?pcard('מחירון דגי החוף',fishPriceGuideHtml('coastal'),'fish'):'',sales=fishShop?pcard('מכירת דגי חוף · מחיר מלא',pnote('דגי אגם נשארים בסל. חנות הדיג ב-C2 קונה גם דגי ים.')+(bag.length?`<div class="fishSetupBag">${bag.map(q=>fishThumbCard(q)+`<button data-b6-sell="${q.catchId}" ${!held?'disabled':''}>מכור · ${money(fishSellValue(q))}</button>`).join('')}</div>`:pnote('אין כרגע דגי חוף בסל. דג שתתפוס יופיע כאן עם תמונה, גודל ושווי.'))+`<div class="phoneActions"><button class="primary" data-b6-sell="" ${!held||!bag.length?'disabled':''}>מכור את כל דגי הים · ${money(value)}</button></div>`,'fish'):'';
 return pcard(fishShop?'חנות דיג החוף':'בית קפה החוף',pkv([['יתרה',money(PlayerProfile.money)],['מיקום','B6 · הטיילת הצפונית']])+pnote(fishShop?'רישיון FISH-A, שישה פיתיונות ימיים, חכות ומכירת דגים. דמוי Plug נשמר אחרי כל הטלה.':'שתייה, פיקניק וציוד לחוף.'),'shop')+rows+priceGuide+sales}

function fishingBaitKey(habitat='lake'){const inv=PlayerProfile.inventory||{},ids=habitat==='coastal'?COAST_BAIT_IDS:LAKE_BAIT_IDS;return ids.find(id=>(inv[id]||0)>0)||null}
function fishingSizeChances(rod,bait,habitat='lake'){const table=habitat==='coastal'?COAST_ROD_SIZE_ODDS:ROD_SIZE_ODDS;let p=[...(table[clamp(rod|0,1,5)]||table[1])],shift=fishingBaitsFor(habitat)[bait]?.sizeShift||[0,0,0,0];p=p.map((v,i)=>Math.max(.1,v+(shift[i]||0)));const sum=p.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)||100;return p.map(v=>v*100/sum)}
function fishingSpeciesWeights(rod,bait,habitat='lake',zone='pier'){const key=LAKE_BAITS[bait]?.key||'bread',idx=COAST_BAITS[bait]?.index||0,rows=fishingSpeciesFor(habitat).filter(q=>rod>=q.minRod);return rows.map(q=>{let w=habitat==='coastal'?q.weights[idx]:q[key]??1;if(habitat==='coastal'){if(['FS-SE-05','FS-SE-07','FS-SE-12'].includes(q.id))w*=.07;if(zone==='rock'&&['FS-SE-05','FS-SE-12'].includes(q.id))w*=1.8;if(zone==='sand'&&q.id==='FS-SE-13')w*=1.7}const rf=(RODS[clamp(rod|0,1,5)-1]||{}).fish||[];return{q,w:Math.max(.005,w)*(1+(Math.max(1,rod)-1)*(q.quality||0)*.10)*(rf.includes(q.id)?1.6:1)}})}
function fishingSpeciesChances(rod,bait,habitat='lake',zone='pier'){const rows=fishingSpeciesWeights(rod,bait,habitat,zone),sum=rows.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.w,0)||1;return rows.map(x=>({id:x.q.id,name:x.q.name,pct:x.w/sum*100,quality:x.q.quality}))}
function fishingQualityProfile(rod,bait,habitat='lake',zone='pier'){const sz=fishingSizeChances(rod,bait,habitat),sp=fishingSpeciesChances(rod,bait,habitat,zone),premium=sp.filter(x=>x.quality>=2).reduce((n,x)=>n+x.pct,0);return{sizes:sz,premium,largePlus:sz[2]+sz[3],trophy:sz[3]}}
function chooseLakeFish(bait,rod,habitat='lake',zone='pier',rnd=Math.random){const rows=fishingSpeciesWeights(rod,bait,habitat,zone),sum=rows.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.w,0);let r=rnd()*sum;for(const x of rows){r-=x.w;if(r<=0)return x.q}return rows[0]?.q||fishingSpeciesFor(habitat)[0]}
function lakeFishSizeIndex(rod,bait,habitat='lake',rnd=Math.random){const p=fishingSizeChances(rod,bait,habitat),r=rnd()*100;if(r<p[0])return 0;if(r<p[0]+p[1])return 1;if(r<p[0]+p[1]+p[2])return 2;return 3}
function fishSellValue(row){const sp=[...LAKE_FISH,...COAST_FISH].find(q=>q.id===row?.id);if(sp){const si=Math.max(0,FISH_SIZE_NAMES.indexOf(row?.size));return Math.max(8,Math.round(sp.value*FISH_VALUE_MULT[si]*(row?.lengthCm||sp.base)/(sp.base||40)))}if(Number.isFinite(row?.value))return row.value;return 18}
function sellLakeFish(catchId=null){ensureEconomySchema();const f=ensureFishingSchema(),shop=activeRetailPurchaseShop(110);if(!shop||shop.id!=='C2-FISH')return toast('מכירת דגים זמינה בחנות הדיג ב-C2');if(!f.inventory.length)return toast('אין דגים למכור');let sold=[];if(catchId){const i=f.inventory.findIndex(q=>q.catchId===catchId);if(i<0)return toast('הדג כבר לא נמצא בתיק');sold=f.inventory.splice(i,1)}else{sold=f.inventory.splice(0,f.inventory.length)}const total=sold.reduce((n,q)=>n+fishSellValue(q),0),count=sold.length;if(!count)return;PlayerProfile.money+=total;f.totalSold+=count;f.totalEarned+=total;recordTransaction('fish-sale',total,{count,shop:shop.id,fish:sold.map(q=>q.id),catchIds:sold.map(q=>q.catchId)});SaveManager.log('fishing','sold',{count,total,catchIds:sold.map(q=>q.catchId)});SaveManager.save('fish-sale',{backup:false,silent:true});toast(count===1?'נמכר '+sold[0].name+' · '+money(total):'נמכרו '+count+' דגים · '+money(total));if(State.phoneOpen)renderPhone()}
function fishingWaitMs(){const waits=[2000,4000,6000,8000,10000,12000];return waits[Math.floor(Math.random()*waits.length)]}
function prepareLakeCatch(spot,bait,rod){const habitat=spot.habitat==='coastal'?'coastal':'lake',sizeIndex=lakeFishSizeIndex(rod,bait,habitat),species=chooseLakeFish(bait,rod,habitat,spot.zone),length=Math.max(habitat==='coastal'?7:12,Math.round(species.base*FISH_SIZE_SCALE[sizeIndex]*(.88+Math.random()*.22))),value=Math.max(8,Math.round(species.value*FISH_VALUE_MULT[sizeIndex]*length/species.base)),caughtAt=iso(),catchId='FISH-'+Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7);return{catchId,id:species.id,name:species.name,size:FISH_SIZE_NAMES[sizeIndex],sizeIndex,lengthCm:length,value,spot:spot.id,habitat,bait,rod,caughtAt}}
function fishingSetupBasketHtml(){const f=ensureFishingSchema(),bag=(f.inventory||[]).slice().reverse(),total=bag.reduce((n,q)=>n+fishSellValue(q),0);return `<div class="pc"><h3>4. סל הדגים שלי</h3>${bag.length?`<div class="fishQualityLine"><span>דגים בסל</span><b>${bag.length}</b></div><div class="fishQualityLine"><span>שווי מכירה נוכחי</span><b>${money(total)}</b></div><div class="fishSetupBag">${bag.map(fishThumbCard).join('')}</div>`:pnote('עדיין אין דגים בסל. הדגים שתתפוס יופיעו כאן מיד עם תמונה, גודל ושווי.')}</div>`}

function renderFishingSetup(){const body=$('fishingSetupBody');if(!body||!State.fishingSetup)return;body.innerHTML=fishingSetupHtml();const b=body.querySelector('[data-fishing-start]'),bait=State.fishingSetup.bait,count=PlayerProfile.inventory[bait]||0;if(b)b.disabled=!bait||count<=0||!FISHX.fitsLv(State.fishingSetup.rod,bait);requestAnimationFrame(()=>{renderFishThumbCanvases(body);fishx7SetupCanvases(body)})}
 
function fishx7SetupCanvases(body){if(typeof FISHX==='undefined'||typeof RODS==='undefined')return;const dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1),Lm=Math.max(...RODS.map(r=>r.len));    
 body.querySelectorAll('[data-fish-rodcv]').forEach(cv=>{try{const rod=RODS[+cv.dataset.fishRodcv-1],W=230,H=40,g=cv.getContext('2d');cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;g.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);g.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  FISHX.rodSide(g,rod,W-8,H*.45,(W-16)/Lm,{min:.7});g.fillStyle='#9fb0bd';g.font='600 10px Segoe UI,Arial';g.textAlign='left';g.fillText(rod.len.toFixed(1)+' מ׳',4,H-3)}catch(e){window.__FX7E=String(e&&e.message||e)}})}
 
function fishx7Card(row,rec){try{let el=document.getElementById('fishCatchCard');if(!el){el=document.createElement('div');el.id='fishCatchCard';document.body.appendChild(el)}el.classList.add('fx8');    
 el.innerHTML=`<div class="ch"><span>נתפס ${row.name}</span>${rec?'<span class="rec">שיא אישי חדש!</span>':row.sizeIndex===3?'<span class="rec">דרגת שיא</span>':''}</div><canvas></canvas><div class="cf"><span>${row.lengthCm} ס״מ</span><span>${FISH_SIZE_HE[row.sizeIndex]||''}</span><span>${money(row.value)}</span></div><div class="cx">לחיצה או F — המשך</div>`;
 const hide=()=>{el.classList.add('out');clearTimeout(fishx7Card.T2);fishx7Card.T2=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show','out'),450)};el.onclick=hide;fishx7Card.hide=hide;
 if(!fishx7Card.K){fishx7Card.K=1;window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if((e.code==='KeyF'||e.code==='Escape')&&document.getElementById('fishCatchCard')?.classList.contains('show'))fishx7Card.hide()},true)}
 const cv=el.querySelector('canvas'),dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1),W=316,H=104,g=cv.getContext('2d');cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;g.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);const q=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);q.addColorStop(0,'#2f6f8f');q.addColorStop(1,'#173b52');g.fillStyle=q;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 const M=fishx8Max(),Lmed=60,gam=Math.max(.5,Math.min(.9,Math.log(.5)/Math.log(Lmed/M))),Ld=(W-20)/1.45*Math.pow(Math.min(1,row.lengthCm/M),gam),ppc=Ld/row.lengthCm;
 FISHX.fishAt(g,row.id,row.lengthCm,W/2+Ld*.5,H/2+4,0,ppc,row.sizeIndex,0,1);
 el.classList.remove('show','out');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('show');el.style.top=Math.max(8,Math.min(96,innerHeight*.5-80-el.offsetHeight))+'px';
 clearTimeout(fishx7Card.T);fishx7Card.T=setTimeout(hide,4500);window.__FX7CARD=(window.__FX7CARD||0)+1;window.__FX8CARD={W:el.offsetWidth,H:el.offsetHeight,top:el.offsetTop,Ld:Math.round(Ld),M:Math.round(M),gam:+gam.toFixed(3)}}catch(e){window.__FX7E=String(e&&e.message||e);toast('נתפס '+row.name+' · '+row.lengthCm+' ס״מ')}}
 
function fishx8Max(){if(fishx8Max.v)return fishx8Max.v;let b=60;try{for(const q of LAKE_FISH)b=Math.max(b,q.base||0);for(const q of COAST_FISH)b=Math.max(b,+q[2]||0)}catch(e){}return fishx8Max.v=b*Math.max(...FISH_SIZE_SCALE)*1.1}

function closeFishingSetup(){State.fishingSetup=null;$('fishingSetupOverlay').classList.remove('show');focusGame()}
function openFishingSetup(spot){const f=ensureFishingSchema();if(!spot)return toast('התקרב לעמדת דיג באגם או בחוף');if(spot.habitat==='coastal'&&(PlayerProfile.mode!=='walk'||Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-spot.x,PlayerPed.y-spot.y)>42))return toast('עמוד ליד נקודת הדיג שעל המזח או בחוף');if(!licenseOwned('LIC-11'))return toast('צריך רישיון FISH-A · חנות הדיג ב-C2 או B6');if(State.fishingSession?.busy)return toast(State.fishingSession.phase==='bite'?'יש נשיכה — לחץ F למשיכה':'החכה כבר במים');const habitat=fishingContext(spot),bait=fishingBaitKey(habitat);State.fishingSpot=spot.id;State.fishingSetup={spot:spot.id,rod:Math.max(1,f.rodLevel||1),bait:FISHX.fitsLv(Math.max(1,f.rodLevel||1),bait)?bait:(Object.keys(fishingBaitsFor(habitat)).find(id=>FISHX.fitsLv(Math.max(1,f.rodLevel||1),id)&&(PlayerProfile.inventory[id]||0)>0)||bait)};$('fishingSetupPanel').querySelector('.sub').textContent=(habitat==='coastal'?'דיג חוף · ':'דיג אגם · ')+spot.label+' · בחר חכה ופיתיון.';$('fishingSetupOverlay').classList.add('show');$('fishingSetupPanel').scrollTop=0;Input.held.clear();renderFishingSetup();return true}
function startFishingFromSetup(){const st=State.fishingSetup;if(!st)return false;const spot=fishingSpotById(st.spot),rod=st.rod,bait=st.bait;if(!spot)return toast('עמדת הדיג לא נמצאה');if(!bait||(PlayerProfile.inventory[bait]||0)<=0){renderFishingSetup();return toast('בחר פיתיון שקיים בתיק')}closeFishingSetup();return startLakeFishing(spot,rod,bait)}
function startLakeFishing(spotArg=null,rodArg=null,baitArg=null){const spot=spotArg||nearbyB2FishingSpot(78)||fishingSpotById(State.fishingSpot),f=ensureFishingSchema();if(!spot)return toast('התקרב לעמדת דיג באגם או בחוף');const habitat=fishingContext(spot),baits=fishingBaitsFor(habitat);if(habitat==='coastal'&&(PlayerProfile.mode!=='walk'||Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-spot.x,PlayerPed.y-spot.y)>28))return toast('התקרב לעמדת הדיג');if(!licenseOwned('LIC-11'))return toast('צריך רישיון FISH-A מחנות הדיג ב-C2 או B6');if(State.fishingSession?.busy)return toast((State.fishingSession.phase==='bite'||State.fishingSession.phase==='reel')?'יש דג על החכה — לחץ F למשיכה':'החכה כבר במים');const rod=clamp(Number(rodArg)||f.rodLevel||1,1,f.rodLevel||1),bait=baitArg;if(!Object.hasOwn(baits,bait)||(PlayerProfile.inventory[bait]||0)<=0)return toast('בחר פיתיון שקיים בתיק');if(!FISHX.fitsLv(rod,bait))return toast('הפיתיון לא מתאים לחכה הזו');if(!baits[bait]?.reusable){PlayerProfile.inventory[bait]--;if(PlayerProfile.inventory[bait]<=0)delete PlayerProfile.inventory[bait]}PlayerPed.dir=spot.dir??(spot.id.endsWith('4')?6:2);const now=performance.now(),waitMs=fishingWaitMs(),session={busy:true,phase:'cast',spot:spot.id,habitat,bait,rod,startedAt:now,castEndsAt:now+450,biteDueAt:now+waitMs,waitMs,hooked:null,reelStartedAt:null,reelDuration:1200,pullCount:0,pullsNeeded:0,escapeAt:null,landing:false};State.fishingSession=session;State.fishingSpot=spot.id;SaveManager.log('fishing','cast',{spot:spot.id,bait,rod,waitMs});SaveManager.save('fishing-cast',{backup:false,silent:true}); return true}
function finishLakeCatch(session){if(!session?.hooked)return false;const f=ensureFishingSchema(),row=session.hooked,prev=f.records[row.id],newRecord=!prev||row.lengthCm>Number(prev.lengthCm||0);f.inventory.push(row);if(f.inventory.length>50)f.inventory.shift();f.totalCaught++;if(newRecord)f.records[row.id]={...row,recordAt:iso()};if(!f.bestValueCatch||Number(row.value||0)>Number(f.bestValueCatch.value||0))f.bestValueCatch={...row,bestValueAt:iso()};State.fishingSession={busy:false,last:row,lastAt:performance.now(),hooked:null};recordTransaction('fish-caught',0,{fish:row.id,size:row.size,lengthCm:row.lengthCm,value:row.value,newRecord});SaveManager.log('fishing','caught',{id:row.id,size:row.size,lengthCm:row.lengthCm,value:row.value,spot:row.spot,rod:row.rod,bait:row.bait,newRecord});syncAchievements(true);SaveManager.save('fishing-catch',{backup:false,silent:true});fishx7Card(row,newRecord);    return true}
function fishPullsNeeded(row){const i=Number.isInteger(row?.sizeIndex)?row.sizeIndex:Math.max(0,FISH_SIZE_NAMES.indexOf(row?.size));return [2,3,4,6][clamp(i,0,3)]}
function fishPullEscapeChance(session){const i=clamp(Number.isInteger(session?.hooked?.sizeIndex)?session.hooked.sizeIndex:0,0,3),base=[.012,.022,.045,.075][i],rod=clamp(session?.rod||1,1,5);return clamp(base-(rod-1)*.009,.004,.10)}
function fishFightRemainingMs(session,now=performance.now()){return Math.max(0,(session?.escapeAt||now)-now)}
function escapeLakeFish(reason='escaped'){const s=State.fishingSession;if(!s?.busy||!s.hooked)return false;const f=ensureFishingSchema(),row=s.hooked;f.totalEscaped++;SaveManager.log('fishing','escaped',{id:row.id,size:row.size,reason,pulls:s.pullCount||0,needed:s.pullsNeeded||0,rod:s.rod,bait:s.bait});State.fishingSession={busy:false,lastEscape:{...row,reason,at:iso()},hooked:null};SaveManager.save('fishing-escape',{backup:false,silent:true});toast(reason==='timeout'?row.name+' ברח — לא משכת בזמן':row.name+' השתחרר מהקרס!');return true}
function reelLakeFishing(){const s=State.fishingSession;if(!s?.busy)return toast('אין חכה פעילה');if(!['bite','reel'].includes(s.phase)||s.landing)return toast(s.landing?'מעלה את הדג…':'עדיין אין נשיכה');const now=performance.now();if(now>=(s.escapeAt||Infinity))return escapeLakeFish('timeout');s.phase='reel';s.pullCount=(s.pullCount||0)+1;SaveManager.log('fishing','pull',{spot:s.spot,id:s.hooked?.id,pull:s.pullCount,needed:s.pullsNeeded});if(s.pullCount<s.pullsNeeded&&Math.random()<fishPullEscapeChance(s))return escapeLakeFish('struggle');if(s.pullCount>=s.pullsNeeded){s.landing=true;s.reelStartedAt=now;s.reelDuration=1200;toast('משיכה אחרונה — הדג עולה!');return true}toast('משוך שוב! '+s.pullCount+'/'+s.pullsNeeded);return true}
function updateFishingActionButton(){const b=$('fishingActionBtn'),s=State.fishingSession;if(!b)return;const active=!!s?.busy&&['bite','reel'].includes(s.phase)&&!s.landing&&!State.phoneOpen&&!State.mapOpen&&!State.fishingSetup;b.classList.toggle('show',active);b.disabled=!active;if(active){const left=(fishFightRemainingMs(s)/1000).toFixed(1),done=s.pullCount||0,need=s.pullsNeeded||1;b.textContent=`🎣 F · משוך! ${done}/${need} · ${left} שנ׳`}else b.textContent='🎣 משוך! (F)'}
function updateFishing(now){const s=State.fishingSession;if(!s?.busy)return;if(s.phase==='cast'&&now>=s.castEndsAt)s.phase='waiting';if(s.phase==='waiting'&&now>=s.biteDueAt){const spot=fishingSpotById(s.spot);if(!spot){State.fishingSession=null;return}s.hooked=prepareLakeCatch(spot,s.bait,s.rod||1);s.phase='bite';s.biteAt=now;s.pullCount=0;s.pullsNeeded=fishPullsNeeded(s.hooked);s.escapeAt=now+7000;s.landing=false;SaveManager.log('fishing','bite',{spot:s.spot,id:s.hooked.id,size:s.hooked.size,waitMs:s.waitMs,rod:s.rod,bait:s.bait,pullsNeeded:s.pullsNeeded});toast('יש נשיכה! '+s.pullsNeeded+' משיכות F · יש לך 7 שניות')}if(['bite','reel'].includes(s.phase)&&!s.landing&&now>=(s.escapeAt||Infinity)){escapeLakeFish('timeout');return}if(s.phase==='reel'&&s.landing&&now-(s.reelStartedAt||now)>=(s.reelDuration||1200))finishLakeCatch(s)}
function fishingActionAtSpot(spot){const s=State.fishingSession;if(s?.busy){if(s.spot!==spot.id)return toast('יש חכה פעילה בעמדה אחרת');if(['bite','reel'].includes(s.phase)&&!s.landing)return reelLakeFishing();if(s.landing)return toast('מעלה את הדג…');return toast('ממתינים לנשיכה…')}if(State.fishingSetup)return true;return openFishingSetup(spot)}
function renderFishThumbCanvases(root=document){root.querySelectorAll('canvas[data-fish-thumb]').forEach(cv=>{const id=cv.dataset.fishThumb,sz=clamp(Number(cv.dataset.fishSize)||1,0,3),isHero=cv.classList.contains('fishHeroThumb'),isBag=cv.classList.contains('fishThumb'),isPrice=!!cv.closest('.fishPriceHead'),W=isHero?210:(isBag?96:(isPrice?88:76)),H=isHero?118:(isBag?54:(isPrice?48:44)),c=cv.getContext('2d');cv.width=W;cv.height=H;c.clearRect(0,0,W,H);c.fillStyle='#17536d';c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);const asset=TurboCity.get(id);if(!asset){c.fillStyle='#dff7ff';c.font='700 11px Segoe UI,Arial';c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='middle';c.fillText('דג',W/2,H/2);return}const I=TurboCity.info(id,{scale:1,sz,variant:0}),sc=Math.min((W-6)/Math.max(1,I.w),(H-4)/Math.max(1,I.h))*1.72,x=(W-I.w*sc)/2,y=(H-I.h*sc)/2;c.save();c.shadowColor='rgba(255,255,255,.38)';c.shadowBlur=3;TurboCity.draw(c,id,x,y,{mode:'runtime',scale:sc,sz,variant:0,time:0});c.restore()})}

function syncAchievements(showToast=false){const A=PlayerProfile.achievements||(PlayerProfile.achievements={}),fresh=[];for(const d of ACHIEVEMENT_DEFS){if(A[d.id])continue;let ok=false;try{ok=!!d.test()}catch(e){}if(ok){A[d.id]={unlockedAt:iso(),name:d.name};fresh.push(d)}}if(showToast&&fresh.length)toast('הישג חדש: '+fresh.map(q=>q.name).join(' · '));if(fresh.length&&!showToast)SaveManager.save('achievements',{backup:false,silent:true});return fresh}

function a4PracticePower(g=State.a4Game){return g?.kind==='tennis'?((g.elapsed-g.roundAt)%1700)/1700:(1+Math.sin((g.elapsed-g.roundAt)/370))/2}
function a4PracticeKeeper(g=State.a4Game,dt=0){return .5+.36*Math.sin((g.elapsed+dt)/610+g.shots*.9)}
function a4Action(action,arg){
 const p=a4Held();if(!p){toast('התקרב ברגל לכניסה או לעמדת האימון ופתח עם F');return false}
 if(action==='save'){SaveManager.save('a4-manual',{backup:false,silent:true});toast('המשחק נשמר');return true}
 if(action==='cancel'){State.a4Game=null;renderPhone();return true}
 if(action==='practice'){
  const q=A4_PRACTICES[arg];if(!q||q.poi!==p.id)return false;if(PlayerProfile.activeMission||State.licenseExam){toast('סיים את המשימה הפעילה לפני האימון');return false}if(State.a4Game&&State.a4Game.phase!=='done')return false;
  State.a4Game={kind:arg,poi:p.id,elapsed:0,roundAt:0,shots:0,score:0,aim:.5,phase:'ready',shotAt:0,shotPower:0,shotAim:.5,result:'',awarded:false,lastDraw:0};renderPhone();return true
 }
 if(action==='shoot'){
  const g=State.a4Game;if(!g||g.poi!==p.id||g.phase!=='ready'||State.paused)return false;
  const power=a4PracticePower(g),aim=g.aim,keeper=a4PracticeKeeper(g,720),hit=g.kind==='basket'?Math.abs(power-.72)<=.105&&Math.abs(aim-.5)<=.12:g.kind==='penalty'?power>=.57&&power<=.84&&aim>=.06&&aim<=.94&&Math.abs(aim-keeper)>.17:power>=.73&&power<=.87;
  Object.assign(g,{phase:'shot',shotAt:g.elapsed,shotPower:power,shotAim:aim,keeperAtShot:keeper,hit,result:hit?'הצלחה ✓':g.kind==='penalty'&&Math.abs(aim-keeper)<=.17?'השוער עצר':'נסה שוב'});g.shots++;if(hit)g.score++;renderPhone();return true
 }
 return false
}

const TC_GRID={cols:[0,1200,2400,3600,4800,6000,7200,8400,9600],rows:[-850,0,850,1700,2550,3400,4250,5200,6050,6900,7750]};
function tcZoneAt(x,y){const C=TC_GRID.cols,R=TC_GRID.rows;let i=-1,j=-1;for(let k=0;k<C.length-1;k++)if(x>=C[k]&&x<C[k+1])i=k;for(let k=0;k<R.length-1;k++)if(y>=R[k]&&y<R[k+1])j=k;
 if(i<0||j<0)return null;const code='ABCDEFGH'[i]+j;return{code,name:TC_NAMES.zones[code]||''}}
function tcStreetAt(x,y){let best=null,bd=1e9;for(const s of TC_NAMES.streets){if(!s.name)continue;const p=s.pts;for(let k=0;k<p.length-1;k++){const ax=p[k][0],ay=p[k][1],bx=p[k+1][0],by=p[k+1][1],dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,L=dx*dx+dy*dy||1,t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-ax)*dx+(y-ay)*dy)/L)),d=Math.hypot(x-ax-t*dx,y-ay-t*dy)-s.hw;if(d<bd){bd=d;best=s}}}
 return best&&bd<=160?best.name:''}
function tcWhereText(x,y){const z=tcZoneAt(x,y);if(!z)return'מחוץ לעיר';const st=tcStreetAt(x,y);return z.code+' · '+z.name+(st?' · '+st:'')}

function saNear(O,x0,y0,x1,y1){const m=200,f=r=>r[0]<x1+m&&r[2]>x0-m&&r[1]<y1+m&&r[3]>y0-m;
 return{edges:O.edges.filter(e=>Math.min(e[0],e[2])-e[4]<x1+m&&Math.max(e[0],e[2])+e[4]>x0-m&&Math.min(e[1],e[3])-e[4]<y1+m&&Math.max(e[1],e[3])+e[4]>y0-m),pave:O.pave.filter(f),rect:O.rect.filter(f),
  circ:O.circ.filter(c=>c[0]>x0-m&&c[0]<x1+m&&c[1]>y0-m&&c[1]<y1+m),obb:O.obb.filter(c=>c[0]>x0-m&&c[0]<x1+m&&c[1]>y0-m&&c[1]<y1+m)}}
function saAsph(O,x,y){for(const e of O.edges){const dx=e[2]-e[0],dy=e[3]-e[1],l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(l2<1)continue;const u=((x-e[0])*dx+(y-e[1])*dy)/l2;if(u<0||u>1)continue;const px=e[0]+dx*u-x,py=e[1]+dy*u-y;if(px*px+py*py<=e[4]*e[4])return true}
 for(const b of O.pave)if(x>=b[0]&&x<=b[2]&&y>=b[1]&&y<=b[3])return true;return false}

function saHit(O,r,pad){const cx=r[0],cy=r[1],c=Math.cos(r[2]),n=Math.sin(r[2]),hl=r[3]/2+pad,hw=r[4]/2+pad,ac=Math.abs(c),an=Math.abs(n);
 for(const q of O.circ){const dx=q[0]-cx,dy=q[1]-cy,u=Math.abs(dx*c+dy*n)-hl,w=Math.abs(-dx*n+dy*c)-hw;if(u<q[2]&&w<q[2]){const ou=Math.max(0,u),ow=Math.max(0,w);if(ou*ou+ow*ow<q[2]*q[2])return q[3]}}
 const ex=ac*hl+an*hw,ey=an*hl+ac*hw;
 for(const b of O.rect){if(cx+ex<=b[0]||cx-ex>=b[2]||cy+ey<=b[1]||cy-ey>=b[3])continue;const bw=(b[2]-b[0])/2,bh=(b[3]-b[1])/2,dx=(b[0]+b[2])/2-cx,dy=(b[1]+b[3])/2-cy;
  if(Math.abs(dx*c+dy*n)>=hl+bw*ac+bh*an)continue;if(Math.abs(-dx*n+dy*c)>=hw+bw*an+bh*ac)continue;return b[4]}
 for(const q of O.obb){const dx=q[0]-cx,dy=q[1]-cy;if(Math.abs(dx)>ex+q[3]+q[4]||Math.abs(dy)>ey+q[3]+q[4])continue;const k=Math.cos(q[2]),m=Math.sin(q[2]);let sep=false;
  for(const [ux,uy] of [[c,n],[-n,c],[k,m],[-m,k]]){const p=Math.abs(dx*ux+dy*uy),ra=hl*Math.abs(c*ux+n*uy)+hw*Math.abs(-n*ux+c*uy),rb=q[3]*Math.abs(k*ux+m*uy)+q[4]*Math.abs(-m*ux+k*uy);if(p>=ra+rb){sep=true;break}}if(!sep)return 'parked:'+q[5]}
 
 const nu=Math.ceil(2*hl/3),nw=Math.ceil(2*hw/3);for(let i=0;i<=nu;i++){const u=-hl+2*hl*i/nu;for(const w of [-hw,0,hw]){const x=cx+c*u-n*w,y=cy+n*u+c*w;if(!saAsph(O,x,y))return 'sidewalk@'+Math.round(x)+','+Math.round(y)}}
 for(let j=1;j<nw;j++){const w=-hw+2*hw*j/nw;for(const u of [-hl,hl]){const x=cx+c*u-n*w,y=cy+n*u+c*w;if(!saAsph(O,x,y))return 'sidewalk@'+Math.round(x)+','+Math.round(y)}}
 return null}

function saSweep(O0,P,s0,s1,tag,out){const G=SEMI_ART,lo=Math.min(s0,s1),hi=Math.max(s0,s1);let x0=1e9,y0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y1=-1e9;for(const q of P){if(q.d<lo-200||q.d>hi+20)continue;x0=Math.min(x0,q.x);y0=Math.min(y0,q.y);x1=Math.max(x1,q.x);y1=Math.max(y1,q.y)}
 const O=saNear(O0,x0,y0,x1,y1),n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil((hi-lo)/G.step));let bad=0;const seen=new Set();
 for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const s=lo+(hi-lo)*i/n,o=saPoseOn(P,s,{}),R=saRects(o);for(let k=0;k<2;k++){const h=saHit(O,R[k],G.pad);if(h){bad++;const key=(k?'trailer ':'tractor ')+h.replace(/@.*/,'');if(!seen.has(key)){seen.add(key);out.hits.push(tag+' · '+(k?'trailer':'tractor')+' × '+h+' @'+Math.round(o.fx)+','+Math.round(o.fy))}}}}
 out.poses+=n+1;out.paths++;if(bad)out.badPaths.push(tag);return bad}

function p636Args(src,i){let d=0,cur='',out=[],q=null;for(let j=i;j<src.length&&j<i+4000;j++){const c=src[j];

  if(c==='('||c==='['||c==='{')d++;else if(c===')'||c===']'||c==='}'){if(d===0){out.push(cur);return out}d--}
  if(c===','&&d===0){out.push(cur);cur=''}else cur+=c}return out}

function g371Head(o,p){const C=G371;if(!C.act)return null;const n=o.node;if(C.vec.has(n))return null;

  const key=n+'|'+sig+'|'+S.toFixed(5)+'|'+qx+qy;let E=C.map.get(key);
  if(!E){if(C.stN<C.stable||C.nw>=C.maxNew){C.vec.add(n);C.stats.vec++;return null}E=g371Make(G,V,S,qx/C.q,qy/C.q);if(!E){C.vec.add(n);C.stats.vec++;return null}C.map.set(key,E);C.bytes+=E.bytes;C.nw++;C.stats.made++}
  E.last=C.fr;E.n=C.n;C.done.add(n);C.stats.hit++;g371Blit(E.cv,ix-E.P,iy-E.P)}

function w3HBox(){if(W3H.box)return W3H.box;let x0=1e9,y0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y1=-1e9;for(const b of W3H.bumps){if(b.later)continue;x0=Math.min(x0,b.x-3.2*b.sx);y0=Math.min(y0,b.y-3.2*b.sy);x1=Math.max(x1,b.x+3.2*b.sx);y1=Math.max(y1,b.y+3.2*b.sy)}

function w3HField(q,X0,Y0,W,H){const Hm=new Float32Array(W*H).fill(W3H.base);for(const b of W3H.bumps){if(b.later)continue;const i0=Math.max(0,Math.floor((b.x-3.2*b.sx-X0)*q)),i1=Math.min(W-1,Math.ceil((b.x+3.2*b.sx-X0)*q)),j0=Math.max(0,Math.floor((b.y-3.2*b.sy-Y0)*q)),j1=Math.min(H-1,Math.ceil((b.y+3.2*b.sy-Y0)*q));

function w3ShadeCv(){if(W3H.cv)return W3H.cv;const t0=performance.now();try{const q=W3H.q,[X0,Y0,BW,BH]=w3HBox(),W=Math.ceil(BW*q),H=Math.ceil(BH*q),Hm=w3HField(q,X0,Y0,W,H),sea=w3HMask(q,X0,Y0,W,H),cm=.1/q;W3H.hm={Hm,X0,Y0,W,H,q};

   const nl=Math.hypot(zx,zy,1),I=(-zx*Lx-zy*Ly+Lz)/nl/Ln,d=I-I0,p=k*4;if(d<0){o[p]=8;o[p+1]=18;o[p+2]=12;o[p+3]=Math.min(150,-d*420)}else{o[p]=255;o[p+1]=250;o[p+2]=226;o[p+3]=Math.min(70,d*260)}}
  g.putImageData(img,0,0);W3H.cv=c;W3H.stats.maxGrade=+mg.toFixed(3);W3H.stats.cityMaxGrade=+cg.toFixed(3)}catch(e){W3H.cv={failed:String(e&&e.message||e)}}W3H.stats.buildMs=Math.round(performance.now()-t0);return W3H.cv}

 const loopB=(t,d)=>{const q=d?inset(d):P;t.moveTo(q[0][0],q[0][1]);for(let i=1;i<=N;i++)t.lineTo(q[i][0],q[i][1]);for(let i=N;i>=0;i--)t.lineTo(q[i][0],-q[i][1]);t.closePath()},loop=(c,d)=>{c.beginPath();loopB(c,d)};

  for(let i=j;i>=0;i--)c.lineTo(b[i][0],-b[i][1]);for(let i=0;i<=j;i++)c.lineTo(b[i][0],b[i][1]);c.closePath()};
 G={D,P,N,hw,inset,loop,loopB,path2,band,line,nose,tail,fromX,lastY,firstY,tyL,arch,zf,zr};VDG.set(id,G);return G}

const hexRGB = h => { const n = parseInt(h.slice(1), 16); return [n >> 16 & 255, n >> 8 & 255, n & 255] };
const rgbS = (c, a) => a == null ? `rgb(${c[0] | 0},${c[1] | 0},${c[2] | 0})` : `rgba(${c[0] | 0},${c[1] | 0},${c[2] | 0},${a})`;

const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
const lerp3 = (p, q, t) => [p[0] + (q[0] - p[0]) * t, p[1] + (q[1] - p[1]) * t, p[2] + (q[2] - p[2]) * t];
const sub3 = (a, b) => [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]];
const cross3 = (a, b) => [a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]];
const norm3 = v => { const n = Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) || 1; return [v[0] / n, v[1] / n, v[2] / n] };
const pwl = (K, x) => { if (x <= K[0][0]) return K[0][1] + (x - K[0][0]) * (K[1][1] - K[0][1]) / (K[1][0] - K[0][0] || 1); for (let i = 1; i < K.length; i++) if (x <= K[i][0]) return lerp(K[i - 1][1], K[i][1], (x - K[i - 1][0]) / (K[i][0] - K[i - 1][0] || 1)); const a = K[K.length - 2], b = K[K.length - 1]; return b[1] + (x - b[0]) * (b[1] - a[1]) / (b[0] - a[0] || 1) };

function geo(id) {

  for (let k = 1; k <= nF; k++) { const f = 1 - k / nF; push(baseEnd(true, f), roofEnd(true, f), 'front', 1) }

  for (let k = nS - 1; k >= 0; k--) { const t = k / nS, xr = lerp(xcr, xcf, t), xb = lerp(bx0, bx1, t); push([xb, baseSideY(xb)], [xr, roofY(xr)], 'side', -1) }
  for (let k = 1; k <= nF; k++) { const f = 1 - k / nF; push(baseEnd(false, f), roofEnd(false, f), 'rear', -1) }
